units.rawText: Oh you. You were wearing your heart on your sleeve - how could I fail to notice what was in it?
units.displayText: Oh you. You were wearing your heart on your sleeve - how could I fail to notice what was in it?

spans.text: Oh you. You were wearing your heart on your sleeve - how could I fail to notice what was in it?

units.rawText: I was the first Doll to meet you on the cloud, after all.
units.displayText: I was the first Doll to meet you on the cloud, after all.

spans.text: I was the first Doll to meet you on the cloud, after all.

units.rawText: The wind sets the strands of her purple hair aflutter, and the fluttering petals in the air only add to its beauty.
units.displayText: The wind sets the strands of her purple hair aflutter, and the fluttering petals in the air only add to its beauty.

spans.text: The wind sets the strands of her purple hair aflutter, and the fluttering petals in the air only add to its beauty.

units.rawText: I produce the proof of our oath from my pocket; the item that symbolizes out promise.
units.displayText: I produce the proof of our oath from my pocket; the item that symbolizes out promise.

spans.text: I produce the proof of our oath from my pocket; the item that symbolizes out promise.

units.rawText: Sangoma... do you wish to entrust the rest of your life to me?
units.displayText: Sangoma... do you wish to entrust the rest of your life to me?

spans.text: Sangoma... do you wish to entrust the rest of your life to me?

units.rawText: Not just on the cloud where we met, but in the real world, where our future lies.
units.displayText: Not just on the cloud where we met, but in the real world, where our future lies.

spans.text: Not just on the cloud where we met, but in the real world, where our future lies.

units.rawText: Hehe... It seems I won't need the "Lovers' Whispers" any more. After all, our hearts are already one.
units.displayText: Hehe... It seems I won't need the "Lovers' Whispers" any more. After all, our hearts are already one.

spans.text: Hehe... It seems I won't need the "Lovers' Whispers" any more. After all, our hearts are already one.

units.rawText: This vision from the oasis steps into the light and takes the hand that I offer.
units.displayText: This vision from the oasis steps into the light and takes the hand that I offer.

spans.text: This vision from the oasis steps into the light and takes the hand that I offer.

units.rawText: I do.
units.displayText: I do.

spans.text: I do.

units.rawText: Regardless of who we are, regardless of what is true or false.
units.displayText: Regardless of who we are, regardless of what is true or false.

spans.text: Regardless of who we are, regardless of what is true or false.

units.rawText: Whether this is nothing more than an illusion, or if it is real... I was drawn to you from the start, and I opened my heart to you.
units.displayText: Whether this is nothing more than an illusion, or if it is real... I was drawn to you from the start, and I opened my heart to you.

spans.text: Whether this is nothing more than an illusion, or if it is real... I was drawn to you from the start, and I opened my heart to you.

units.rawText: Sangoma's smile is filled with her love. A gentle breeze has finally carried this scent to her abode.
units.displayText: Sangoma's smile is filled with her love. A gentle breeze has finally carried this scent to her abode.

spans.text: Sangoma's smile is filled with her love. A gentle breeze has finally carried this scent to her abode.

units.rawText: I will spend the rest of my life by your side.
units.displayText: I will spend the rest of my life by your side.

spans.text: I will spend the rest of my life by your side.

units.rawText: In sickness, or in health, till death do us part.
units.displayText: In sickness, or in health, till death do us part.

spans.text: In sickness, or in health, till death do us part.

units.rawText: My, how weighty this love is.
units.displayText: My, how weighty this love is.

spans.text: My, how weighty this love is.

units.rawText: It's too late for you to regret it now~
units.displayText: It's too late for you to regret it now~

spans.text: It's too late for you to regret it now~

units.rawText: And why would I regret it? You are my beloved lilac, after all.
units.displayText: And why would I regret it? You are my beloved lilac, after all.

spans.text: And why would I regret it? You are my beloved lilac, after all.

units.rawText: I slowly slip the symbol of eternity onto her ring finger. Then, our fingers touch, before meshing into each other.
units.displayText: I slowly slip the symbol of eternity onto her ring finger. Then, our fingers touch, before meshing into each other.

spans.text: I slowly slip the symbol of eternity onto her ring finger. Then, our fingers touch, before meshing into each other.

units.rawText: We pay no heed to the fading light of the setting sun. Instead, as we gaze into each other's eyes, there are more words in there than we could ever finish saying to each other.
units.displayText: We pay no heed to the fading light of the setting sun. Instead, as we gaze into each other's eyes, there are more words in there than we could ever finish saying to each other.

spans.text: We pay no heed to the fading light of the setting sun. Instead, as we gaze into each other's eyes, there are more words in there than we could ever finish saying to each other.

units.displayText: What is it?

units.rawText: I'll be in your hands now.
units.displayText: I'll be in your hands now.

spans.text: I'll be in your hands now.

units.rawText: Yes, and my future is in yours, Sangoma.
units.displayText: Yes, and my future is in yours, Sangoma.

spans.text: Yes, and my future is in yours, Sangoma.
